_comment: RIVER BIOMES AND THE GIANT'S BIOMES. Tectonic's version of this file is add(terra_continental:biome_parameter/ridges, 0). First, where the ground is high (offset continents from 0.15 to 0.3, roughly +60 to +120), weirdness near 0 (vanilla's river band) is stretched away from 0, so river biomes stay along real rivers (spawning needs them) but not on high ground (the user, 2026-10-24). Then, within 0.8 of each giant massif's radius (terra_continental:giant_peaks, output mask), weirdness is pulled toward +-0.667 by its own sign, where vanilla's peaks-and-valleys is 1 (peaks); pulling everything toward +0.667 carried negative values through 0 and drew a ring of river biome round each giant. Biome selection only; terrain reads terra_continental:noise/continent/ridges_folded. Generated by preview/shape_pack.py (high_river_biomes, giant_biome).
